sample_plan.subpopulation_description: U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 0–4 inclusive, within the supplied age 0–14 group. Includes infants and very young children; no independently pursued hobbies, reading, cooking, gaming, adult work, or technology habits are assigned.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 5–14 inclusive, within the supplied age 0–14 group. Leisure interests and other optional activities are left unconstrained for this broad child age band.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 15–24 inclusive, within the supplied age 15–24 group. This broad youth and young-adult band is not assigned adult employment, attainment, or public-opinion profiles.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 15–24 inclusive, within the supplied age 15–24 group, with a compatible White non-Hispanic cultural-background profile. No adult employment or advanced-education restriction is imposed on this broad age band.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 25–54 inclusive, within the supplied age 25–54 group. This directive provides an adult low-literacy/limited-schooling profile without prescribing other demographics.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 25–54 inclusive, within the supplied age 25–54 group. Includes singleton contrasts in spicy-food preference and a strongly progressive belief profile; other demographic choices remain open.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 25–54 inclusive, within the supplied age 25–54 group. Includes singleton contrasts in plant-based food preference, resistance to new products, and strongly conservative beliefs; no race, gender, or income pairing is imposed.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 25–54 inclusive, within the supplied age 25–54 group. Draws employed labor-force participants across the listed employed occupations, with no separate party-affiliation restriction.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 55–64 inclusive, within the supplied age 55–64 group. Includes adventurous food tastes, a singleton skeptical/hostile attitude contrast, and a varied travel profile; demographic dimensions remain open.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 55–64 inclusive, within the supplied age 55–64 group, living in a rural settlement. This small rural allocation is paired explicitly with the rural lifestyle profile.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 65–110 inclusive, within the supplied age 65 and older group, living in an urban settlement. This directive includes contrasting older-adult lifestyle, health, and taste profiles.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 65–110 inclusive, within the supplied age 65 and older group. Includes an older-adult caregiving/lifestyle profile and contrasts in health, technology, and travel habits.

U.S. residents (of any citizenship or residency status) aged 65–110 inclusive, within the supplied age 65 and older group, with a compatible multiracial cultural-background profile. Other demographic and behavioral dimensions remain unconstrained or broadly eligible.
